annotations.title: Validate a Latin American or Spanish tax ID

description: Check the format and check digit of a tax ID: RUT (CL), CUIT/CUIL (AR), CPF/CNPJ including alphanumeric CNPJ (BR), RFC (MX), RUC (PE), NIT (CO), NIF/NIE (ES). Use cl_rut for Chile when you also want the normalized format. Does not confirm registration with the tax authority. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST /validate/tax-id via x402.

id.description: The ID with or without dots and dashes, e.g. 12.345.678-5.

name: validate_tax_id
